event_time_chk.name: event_time_chk
event_time_chk.value:
("events"."all_day" and "events"."start_date" is not null and "events"."end_date" is not null and "events"."end_date" >= "events"."start_date")
        or (not "events"."all_day" and "events"."starts_at" is not null and "events"."ends_at" is not null and "events"."ends_at" > "events"."starts_at")

project_dates_chk.name: project_dates_chk
project_dates_chk.value: "projects"."due_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."due_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

task_due_time_chk.name: task_due_time_chk
task_due_time_chk.value: "tasks"."due_time" is null or "tasks"."due_date" is not null
